title: 8.2 Proving Triangle Similarity by AA

icans: I can use two pairs of congruent angles to show two triangles are similar.
I can write a similarity statement with the vertices in the correct order.
I can use similar triangles to find a missing length, including a height I can’t measure directly.

vocab: if two angles of one triangle are ____________ to two angles of another triangle, the triangles are similar
finding a length with similar ____________ instead of measuring it
an angle is ____________ to itself (a shared angle)
opposite angles formed by two _______________ lines; they are congruent

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Discovery: two angles are enough

blocks.p: Draw a base of the length your teacher gives you: ________ cm. At one end draw a 40° angle and at the other end a 65° angle. Extend the sides until they meet.
What do you notice about the third angles? About the three ratios?

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: AA Similarity Theorem: if two _______________ of one triangle are congruent to two _______________ of another triangle, then the triangles are _______________.
Similarity statements: Write the similarity statement so the _______________ angles are in the same positions.

blocks.stem: Determine whether the triangles are similar. If they are, write a similarity statement.
△JKL has angles of 48° and 85°. △MNP has angles of 48° and 57°. Are the triangles similar? Explain.

notes: Where congruent angles come from: Congruent angles can come from a shared angle, _______________ angles, or _______________ lines cut by a transversal.

blocks.stem: In △ABC, D̅E̅ ∥ B̅C̅. Show that △ADE ~ △ABC. Then find BC when AD = 6, AB = 15, and DE = 8.

notes: Indirect measurement: use _______________ triangles to find a length you cannot measure directly (like a height from shadows).

blocks.stem: A 6-foot-tall person casts a 4-foot shadow. At the same time, a flagpole casts a 30-foot shadow. How tall is the flagpole?
A̅B̅ ∥ D̅E̅, and A̅E̅ and B̅D̅ intersect at C. AB = 18, AC = 12, and EC = 8. Find DE.
△PQR has m∠P = 90° and m∠Q = 35°. △STU has m∠S = 55° and m∠T = 90°. Are the triangles similar? If so, write a similarity statement.
A 5-foot-tall student casts a 3-foot shadow. At the same time, a tree casts a 24-foot shadow. How tall is the tree?

tickets.stem: △ABC has angles of 52° and 61°. △DEF has angles of 61° and 67°. Are the triangles similar? Explain.
In △ABC, D̅E̅ ∥ B̅C̅ with D on A̅B̅ and E on A̅C̅. AD = 4, AB = 10, and DE = 6. Find BC.
A 4-foot post casts a 6-foot shadow. At the same time, a building casts a 45-foot shadow. How tall is the building?
